security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' https://*.scdn.co data:; connect-src 'self' https://api.spotify.com https://accounts.spotify.com https://ws.audioscrobbler.com; font-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Find what's missing from your Spotify library
bundle.longDescription: DeepDive reconciles an artist's Spotify catalogue against your Liked Songs, finds the tracks you're missing, and builds playlists from your own library. No account, no server: everything stays on your device.
